blocks.tamil_translation: Lord and also fulfilled well the duties of his master.” Hazrat Abdullah ibn Umar (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِاللهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ﵄ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: ثَلَاثَةٌ عَلَي كُثْبَانِ الْمِسْكِ - أُرَاهُ قَالَ - يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يَغْبِطُهُمُ اْلاَوَّلُونَ وَاْلآخِرُونَ: رَجُلٌ يُنَادِي بِالصَّلَوَاتِ الْخَمْسِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ وَلَيْلَةٍ، وَرَجُلٌ يَؤُمُّ قَوْماً وَهُمْ بِهِ رَاضُونَ، وَعَبْدٌ أَدَّي حَقَّ اللهِ وَحَقَّ مَوَالِيهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال: هذا حديث حسن غريب باب احاديث في صفة الثلاثة الذين يحبهم الله رقم:٢٥٦٦
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Umar (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said, “Three kinds of people will be seated on mounds of musk on the Day of Qiyamah; all those of earlier and later times will envy them on seeing them. The first kind is the one who called the Adhan for the five daily Salahs, night and day. The second kind is the Imam who led the people in Salah while the people were pleased with him. The third kind is the slave who fulfilled the duties of Allah and also fulfilled the duties of his master.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: اَلْإِمَامُ ضَامِنٌ وَالْمُؤَذِّنُ مُؤْتَمَنٌ، اَللّهُمَّ! أَرْشِدِ اْلاَئِمَّةَ وَاغْفِرْ لِلْمُؤَذِّنِينَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب ما يجب علي المؤذن ....، رقم:٥١٧
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, “The Imam is responsible, the Mu'adhdhin is trusted. “O Allah, guide the Imams aright, and forgive the sins of the Mu'adhdhins!”
